The meatloaf slice has a textured, browned crust and a lighter, dense interior visible at the cut edge. It is topped with a glossy, dark reddish-brown glaze that pools around the base. A fork rests on the plate behind the meatloaf, partially out of focus. There appear to be other food items or sauce remnants in the background.
